mini_story.ten: Mini-story - Tốc độ và chiến thuật
mini_story.truyen: Effective productivity depends significantly upon maintaining a consistent workflow and prioritising critical tasks throughout a standard working day. Firstly, strategic planning allows individuals to manage their time efficiently by focusing energy on high-value projects before mental fatigue sets in. Secondly, maintaining a steady pace prevents burnout and ensures that quality remains high during prolonged periods of concentration at home. Nam begins his morning by organising his workspace and identifying his primary objectives for the day. He works methodically through complex reports, treating each completed section as a small tactical victory. The house remains quiet as he avoids social media distractions to preserve his cognitive focus. By midday, he experiences a steady rhythm of progress that feels sustainable and productive. However, he soon realises that he overestimates his endurance for repetitive tasks. He decides to alter his approach by introducing scheduled intervals of physical activity to refresh his mind. This small change transforms his afternoon from a period of sluggish performance into an energetic and highly efficient session. He finishes his work feeling accomplished rather than exhausted because he adapts his tactics to his actual performance levels.
